subject: Security

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header is set; the pipeline also serves Swagger UI and Scalar HTML pages
findings.standard: OWASP Content Security Policy Cheat Sheet
findings.recommendation: Add security-header middleware (for example NetEscapades.AspNetCore.SecurityHeaders or a small custom middleware) that sets `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'` on API responses. Use a looser policy only for the Swagger/Scalar UI routes.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: Strict-Transport-Security is never set (no UseHsts in the pipeline)
findings.recommendation: Call `webApp.UseHsts()` when the environment is not Development, before the other middleware.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff is not set

evidence.excerpt: public static void ApiWebApplication(this WebApplication webApp) ... no security-header middleware registered

findings.recommendation: Add `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` to every response from the same security-header middleware.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: No clickjacking protection (no X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors)
findings.recommendation: Send `X-Frame-Options: DENY` and/or the CSP directive `frame-ancestors 'none'` on all responses, including the Swagger and Scalar UI pages.

findings.subject: Security
findings.title: HTTPS redirection is enabled only in Development (the condition is inverted), and the launch profile listens on HTTP only
findings.recommendation: Call `UseHttpsRedirection()` (with `UseHsts()`) in every environment except Development, or reject HTTP at the edge. Also add an HTTPS URL to the launch profile.

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: Global exception middleware returns a ProblemDetails body with only a generic user message; stack traces are logged on the server and never returned

evidence.excerpt: var problemDetails = new ProblemDetails { Status = 500, Title = "Internal Server Error", Detail = loggingCorrelation.UserMessage, ...

strengths.subject: Security
strengths.title: No permissive CORS policy is registered, so browsers keep the default same-origin restriction

checkResults.subject: Security
checkResults.reason: No Content-Security-Policy header is configured anywhere in the pipeline.
